site.name: Denis
site.intro: I shape raw footage into stories with rhythm, emotion and a pulse. Music videos, commercials, reels, weddings and short films - cut with intent, graded with taste.
site.about:
I am a video editor obsessed with the invisible craft: the cut that lands on the beat, the sound design that makes a frame breathe, the grade that sets the mood before anyone speaks.
From fast-paced social content to long-form storytelling, I work closely with directors, artists and brands to turn hours of footage into something people actually remember.
Available for freelance projects worldwide. Tell me about your next one.
